current.text: He is projected to start for OKC in Lu Dort's old spot. The only open question is Ajay Mitchell starting instead of him.
OKC lost Lu Dort, Aaron Wiggins and Isaiah Joe over the offseason, which opened the starting spot.
OKC will also have to give more minutes to Ajay Mitchell and Jared McCain.
He may play about 30 minutes and score in double digits.
As a starter he should stay in a 3-and-D role, maybe doing more off the catch as a secondary playmaker. He may get more on-ball chances in bench minutes as the season goes on.
Last season he played well as lead guard and lead scorer when SGA, Jalen Williams and Mitchell were out. When there was an extra ball-handling role, the team picked him over Mitchell.
He is in the final year of his rookie deal and heading toward restricted free agency. He has said he wants a bigger role.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with an undisclosed issue.

Experts see him as a late pick worth about 1 USD who should be drafted, but not high. Drafters have taken him too early in mocks, around pick 105 and for 8 USD. Do not let the steals inflate his price.
OKC has a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Its schedule is pretty good with a March 28 end date.
OKC is projected to win about 62 games and be a top two seed in the West.

durable.text: Steals are his one standout category. He projects for about 2 steals per game, far above the top 250 pool.
He is a one-category player. His points, threes, rebounds, assists, blocks and FG% are all bad, and his FT% is average on low volume.
He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues. He is barely top 150 in points formats and not worth drafting in 12-team points leagues.

note: Wallace is a steals specialist (about 2 per game, z +3.2) with below-average numbers almost everywhere else. Yahoo and ESPN value him at 2 USD with average costs near 1 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. That fits the experts' 1 USD view, so take him as a cheap late steals source and do not pay the 8 USD or pick-105 prices seen in mocks. Early in the season, check his Yahoo Q status, whether he keeps the starting job over Ajay Mitchell, and whether his minutes get near 30.
